findings.description: The woman's torso is emerging directly out of the solid metal hood and cowl area of the station wagon, right in front of the intact windshield glass, with no opening or physical space for her lower body.

Initially there is a single rectangular badge on the cream-colored paint above the wood paneling. At 00:02 a second identical badge materializes on the wood paneling directly below it, and by 00:04 the original upper badge vanishes completely.
